repeat1.scope: First fresh full repeat for optimized candidate.

repeat2.scope: Second fresh full repeat; reversed corpus order and first method rotation.

ordering: Two full repeats. Reverse corpus order between blocks; shuffle each corpus with order_seed+100*block_index+corpus_index; first method rotation is (query_index+block_index)%2. Every full corpus has exactly balanced first positions. Freeze exact schedule before either block.
measurement: Original PNML/XML, Rust parse and all property branches within one strict five-second outer invocation. Separate bounded independent Python translation and certificate checking outside solver timing. Portable process-tree RSS sampling with termination at observed 2GiB; not a Linux cgroup guarantee. One local invocation at a time; no benchmarks or builds overlap.
analysis: Report each full repeat, both corpora and each family, on all368 original slots and366 exact ordered-branch representatives. Accepted definitive answers require separate bounded original-input checking. Report paired gains/losses, solved intersection/union across the two repeats, solver PAR-2, and actual solver plus validator wall time. Common-solved timings use queries solved by both methods in both new blocks. The earlier grouped-only screen is a separate candidate, not a repeat of this one. Retain every outcome, no filtering or replacement runs.
launch_gate: Preparation and freeze never launch a solver. Parent must authorize optimized candidate after build/checker tests. Prior grouped-only full audit must pass and its terminal must be complete. No local build or other benchmark overlap. Candidate/source changes require new campaign, not replacement rows.
claim_scope: Two local development repeats of optimized candidate versus frozen baseline. Coverage repeatability, not precise confidence intervals or held-out generalization. Original grouped-only screen uses a distinct binary and is not pooled. Validator costs reported separately and summed for actual end-to-end cost; no performance counters.
candidate_design: Grouped-excess negative certificates, original-net divided-marking guided walks and ordinary guided walks before reduction, divided-marking relaxed search and prior fallbacks; guard threshold walk indexing, relaxed action indexes, acyclic count realization and bounded arithmetic precheck construction. CLI auto chooses portfolio-excess for ordinary input and retains raw-potential for raw input. Both measured engines explicitly enable buffer agglomeration.
